verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes the source of one first-party component, the official Gusto CLI, publicly on GitHub under the Apache-2.0 license, and its repo files (such as AGENTS.md) can be fetched without a key. Nothing shows the core payroll platform, the APIs or the React SDK being open-source, so only a peripheral part of the product's source is readable under an open license. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core Gusto/Embedded Payroll product, licensing evidence for the SDK and client libraries, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Gusto ships an official public CLI: github.com/Gusto/gusto-cli
The repo ships a first-party AGENTS.md, served 200 to a keyless curl at raw.githubusercontent.com/Gusto/gusto-cli/main/AGENTS.md
